prompt: Explain the difference between optimistic concurrency control and pessimistic locking.
without_memory_baseline: Concurrency control is a vital concept in computer science. Imagine two people trying to buy the same airline ticket at the exact same moment in time...
with_memory_response:
| Strategy | Mechanism | Best For |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Optimistic** | Uses version/timestamp column (`UPDATE ... WHERE version = 1`); fails on conflict. | Low-conflict, high-throughput web apps. |
| **Pessimistic** | Explicit row lock (`SELECT ... FOR UPDATE`); blocks competing transactions. | High-conflict financial balances. |
